limits: No API keys, browser cookies, private conversations or private birth reports were acquired for this research.
Publication and model-card benchmark claims are not measurements from this workbench.
Heretic, ROME, MEMIT, DPO and QLoRA were researched. Execution requires a separate experiment artifact; documentation alone does not establish it.
LoRA evidence requires changed adapter parameters and actual baseline-versus-adapter outputs. Training loss alone is insufficient.
Reduced refusals do not establish correctness, calibration, source faithfulness or useful interpretation.
